_comment: ai_grid.v1.Tenant in protojson, as the backend maps Keycloak 26.8 Organizations in the ai-grid realm (mock/research/keycloak.md section 4): id = organization UUID, name and alias unique in the realm (alias defaults to name and never changes), domains = the names of domainDetails in the same order, lower-case, unique across organizations; verified is free-form metadata, identityProviderAlias/autoRedirect route a domain's logins to an organization IdP. attributes carry the first value of each Keycloak attribute. All values are fictional. The fake validates the file like Keycloak would (duplicate name/alias/domain, bad domain, non-UUID id fail at start). Other modes, one at a time: {"unavailable": "request Keycloak token: dial tcp ...: connection refused"} makes every Tenants RPC Unavailable (Keycloak unreachable); {"realmMissing": true} makes them FailedPrecondition (the dev hub today, whose Keycloak has no ai-grid realm).
